description: Color the two horizontal screen extremes L/R blue and the other three existing vertices T/F/B red. This targets mistaking screen extremes for the two bipyramid apices, assigning the blue pair 5 and red triple1 and reporting13. Every marker coincides with a frozen existing vertex; no graph edge, face, or number changes.
